name: Henesys Field
description: Rolling meadows dotted with mushrooms. Perfect for beginners.
bossMechanic: Summons minion mushrooms. Kill them before they heal her.

name: Ellinia Treetops
description: Towering blue trees housing fairies and flying creatures.
bossMechanic: Inflicts Curse debuff that halves DPS for 4 seconds.

name: Kerning City Sewers
description: Dark underground tunnels crawling with thugs and lizards.
bossMechanic: Steals 15% of meso rewards on boss stage. Defeat quickly.

name: Perion Wasteland
description: A scorched wasteland where warriors first found glory.
bossMechanic: Armored phases — damage reduced by 60% until staggered at 50% HP.

name: Sleepywood Dungeon
description: An ancient dungeon beneath a sleepy town, sealed for good reason.
bossMechanic: Absorbs nearby slimes to restore HP. AOE clear bonuses apply.

name: Ludibrium Clocktower
description: A giant toy clocktower where blocks and dolls have come to life.
bossMechanic: Rewinds time — restores 25% HP every 8 seconds. Burst it down.

name: Omega Sector
description: A secret military base guarding against extra-terrestrial threats.
bossMechanic: Energy shield absorbs 40% damage. Disabled for 5 seconds after AOE hit.

name: El Nath Ice Fields
description: Frozen tundra at the roof of the world. Brutal cold slows progress.
bossMechanic: Blizzard attack freezes for 3 seconds every 15 seconds. Time skills around freeze.

name: Ice Valley II
description: Deep ice caverns where ancient demons were sealed away.
bossMechanic: Dark aura halves healing. Activates at 30% HP — burst kill required.

name: Aqua Road
description: Underwater highways teeming with sea monsters and ancient ruins.
bossMechanic: Spawns twin form — both must die within 10 stages of each other.

name: Minar Forest
description: Ancient forest home to dragons and scholars of lost magic.
bossMechanic: Dragon Breath deals triple damage once per boss fight. Block with Shield Wall.

name: Dragon Nest
description: The sacred hatching grounds of Maple World's eldest dragons.
bossMechanic: Aerial phase — grounded attacks deal 50% less. Use Snipe or burst skills.

name: Mu Lung Gardens
description: Serene bamboo gardens where ancient masters train in forgotten arts.
bossMechanic: Kung Fu stance: randomly immune to physical or magic for 5 seconds.

name: Nihal Desert
description: Endless dunes hiding nomads, sandworms, and buried treasure.
bossMechanic: Sandstorm blocks skills for 6 seconds. Passive damage only during storm.

name: Magatia Alchemy City
description: A city of alchemists split between the Zenumist and Alcadno factions.
bossMechanic: Regenerates 3% HP per second. Must be killed within 60 seconds.

name: Singapore Streets
description: Neon-lit city streets where gangs and monsters battle for turf.
bossMechanic: Two-eye mechanic — each eye has separate HP. Left eye heals if right survives.

name: New Leaf City
description: A dark alternate Maple World overrun by shadow creatures.
bossMechanic: Rage form at 40% HP — all damage doubled both ways. Execute skill instant-kills.

name: Crimsonwood Keep
description: Ancient stronghold of warriors sworn to oppose the Black Mage.
bossMechanic: Headless phase — attacks miss 50% of the time. Deal 5× damage when head returns.

name: Zipangu — Mushroom Shrine
description: Sacred shrine grounds haunted by spirits and celestial beasts.
bossMechanic: Illusion split — creates 2 clones. Only the real one takes damage.

name: Leafre — Dragon Skies
description: High above the canopy where ancient sky dragons patrol the clouds.
bossMechanic: Lightning storm charges every 10 stages — one-shots if not burst down first.

name: Temple of Time
description: An eternal monument where time itself fractures. Only the worthy may enter.
bossMechanic: Resets stage timer — boss resets to full HP once unless killed in one tick burst.

name: Black Mage's Lair
description: The final darkness. The source of all evil in Maple World awaits.
bossMechanic: World Seal — all DPS cut by 80% for 5 seconds. Relics and Rebirth count offset the seal.
